preconditions.description: Attacker must have whitelist admin role to call lock functions
Attacker must have some PLENTYCOIN tokens to lock

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the unlock() function where _lockedAmount.sub() is called without checking for underflow. First, become a whitelist admin (or use an existing admin account). Then lock some tokens using lock() or transferFromWithLock(). Wait for lock period to expire. Call unlock() which will transfer tokens back and attempt to subtract from _lockedAmount. Due to missing updates in lock(), transferFromWithLock(), and increaseLockAmount(), _lockedAmount may be lower than actual locked tokens, causing underflow. This underflow will wrap _lockedAmount to a very high value, disrupting the contract's swapAndLiquify logic (which uses balanceOf(address(this)).sub(_lockedAmount)). This could allow attacker to manipulate contract balances and potentially extract value through swapAndLiquify mechanism.
